From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Intro follow-up & proposed 30-minute demo windows — OrbitAI

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today, appreciated the overview of OrbitAI’s inference bottlenecks and how you prioritize latency vs. cost across different pipelines. Quick recap and proposal for next steps: 

Recap (1–2 bullets):
- Primary goal: reduce per-inference latency on multi-stage pipelines while keeping unit cost within current budget envelope.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (CTO) for architecture, Maya (product) for feature fit; ops team will want retention/audit details.

Suggested next step:
- 30-minute intro demo (high-level product walk + Q&A) to show typical throughput/latency tradeoffs and our rollout options.

I can offer these three windows (Pacific time):
- Option A: Tue Dec 13 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Thu Dec 15 — 13:00–13:30 PT
- Option C: Mon Dec 19 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Please tell me which of these works best for you and who from your side will join (I saw Maya and Alex mentioned on the call). If none work, feel free to propose two alternatives and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a short one-pager and a mutual action plan that outlines typical agenda and stakeholder asks.

Prep notes: if you can share a brief list of data retention / audit requirements ahead of time, we’ll include our security lead on the call.

Calendar poll / direct booking: https://cal.example.com/aditya/30min
Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll wait for a preferred slot and will confirm immediately.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
